# Source of desert_ground_tiles.aseprite and .png (python tools/sprite/sprite.py build <this> <out.aseprite>).

# green_land_tile_set's ground source at it). The ash desert (levels 37-42): dune sand e0c08a with a f0dcaa rim, block 1 = packed dunes c4a06c, pale
# sand = bone-white salt flats d8d0c0/ece6d8, sand = red dust road b8784e/c88a5c, red = cracked hardpan 9a5a3a,
# bog = oasis reeds and mud
